title: Decision Making Needs Uncertainty Quantification [Lecture Notes]
abstract: arXiv:2607.14407v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many signal processing systems ultimately exist to act. Whenever the state variable that determines the action to be taken by a decision maker, or agent, is uncertain, the way that uncertainty is represented decides how well the agent performs and how much its performance can be trusted. This lecture note develops, from first principles and within a single decision-theoretic setting, the link between the {objective} and the knowledge of an agent and the form of uncertainty representation that is sufficient to act optimally. To start, assuming a known environment distribution, we show that a risk-neutral agent needs the posterior distribution over the state, whereas a risk-averse agent can rely without loss of optimality on a {prediction set} and a worst-case decision rule. translated_title: 决策制定需要不确定性量化【讲义】
translated_abstract: 许多信号处理系统最终都是为了执行行动而存在的。每当决定决策者（即智能体）所采取行动的状态变量存在不确定性时，这种不确定性的表示方式就决定了智能体的表现优劣以及其表现的可信程度。本讲义从第一性原理出发，在统一的决策理论框架内，建立了智能体的目标与其知识之间的联系，以及足以实现最优行动的不确定性表示形式。首先，在假设环境分布已知的条件下，我们证明风险中性的智能体需要状态的后验分布，而风险厌恶的智能体可以依靠预测集和最坏情况决策规则而不损失最优性。随后，我们转向环境分布未知的情况，并识别出三种互补的方法来应对由此产生的认知不确定性：校准（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本讲义从决策理论基本原理出发证明，最优决策所需的不确定性表示取决于智能体的风险偏好——风险中性智能体需要后验分布，风险厌恶智能体可依赖预测集与最坏情况决策规则，并进一步提出应对环境未知时认知不确定性的互补方法。
en_tdlr: This lecture note derives from first principles the uncertainty representations sufficient for optimal decision making—showing that risk-neutral agents require the posterior distribution while risk-averse agents can rely on prediction sets with worst-case decision rules—and identifies complementary approaches for addressing epistemic uncertainty under unknown environments.
